title: Preserve food before expanding the larder
applies_when: Perishable food is spoiling or a larger reserve is planned.
approach: Keep raw crops protected and cook manageable batches. Prioritize meat and prepared meals for cooling; inspect their actual rot timers.
For a freezer, use an enclosed roofed room with the cooler cold side inside and heat exhausted outside. Supply power and set a below-freezing target.
Check measured room temperature before trusting the freezer. Leave expansion room, but do not build a huge cold room before there is food and power to justify it.
verify: Actual temperature, cooler orientation, power, open doors and storage filters.
reconsider: Hot weather or power loss raises temperature; reduce stored perishables or improve cooling.
